summary: Tested the Priority 1 'ERG Mechanical Failure' struggle-detection refinement (erg_spiral gate in struggle.ts + dynamic easePct in workout.tsx + updated coach.py prompt wording). Backend regression suite test_iter112_struggle_and_debrief.py: 4/4 PASSED against the live preview URL. Independently re-verified the mean/std/CV boolean-gate math with a standalone Node script (firing case + non-firing control case) — both matched the developer's own findings exactly (powerDeficitPct>0.10, avgCad<75, cadenceVariancePct>0.10 all true only in the firing case). Frontend: logged in as demo@roujaune.app, confirmed Workouts list -> workout detail -> Start Workout correctly loads the live workout HUD (ELAPSED timer ticking, TERRAIN/ROUTE/INTERVAL panels, ERG-related testIDs present x3, pause control present) with no red-screen or console errors. Could NOT drive the exact 10s power<target-10% + cadence<75rpm + high-CV telemetry pattern through the web/simulated UI to visually observe the new 'Trainer eased ERG −5% · cadence + power collapsing' toast — this matches the review_request's own expectation that this is best-effort/hard to trigger via UI, so it is reported as untestable via current tooling, not a failure. /summary screen rendered correctly with no crash (verified on an existing completed ride).
verified_working: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter112_struggle_and_debrief.py -> 4/4 PASSED (test_struggle_cue_returns_200, test_safety_cue_returns_200_calm, test_live_cue_regression, test_debrief_with_struggles_200) against https://scenic-trainer.preview.emergentagent.com.

POST /api/coach/cue with cue_kind='struggle' and struggle_reasons including 'erg_spiral' returns 200 with a valid non-empty text cue -- confirms the updated erg_spiral prompt wording in coach.py did not break the contract.

POST /api/coach/debrief with struggles[] (including an 'erg_spiral' reason entry) returns 200 with a valid debrief text >20 chars -- 'erg_spiral' -> 'ERG spiral' label mapping in coach.py debrief code unchanged and working.

Standalone Node re-verification of the mean/std/coefficient-of-variation boolean gate (powerDeficitPct>0.10 AND avgCad<75 AND cadenceVariancePct>0.10, ergMode+trainerOn required) against a firing scenario (avgPower 200W vs target 250W, erratic cadence 45-95rpm, avgCad 69.8) -> fires=true, and a non-firing control (avgPower 248.6W vs 250W target, steady cadence ~88-91rpm) -> fires=false. Both match expected outcomes and the developer's own isolated verification.

Code review of struggle.ts confirms erg_spiral fires standalone (active = safety || reasons.includes('erg_spiral') || reasons.length>=2) independent of the general 2-signal rule, and easePct is correctly set to 0.05 for erg_spiral primary, 0.08 for general multi-signal, 0.45 for safety -- matching the spec's Priority-1 5% ERG drop exactly.

Code review of workout.tsx onStruggle/onSafety confirms dynamic s.easePct is used (no hardcoded 8%/45%) and the toast text branches correctly: mechanical (primary==='erg_spiral') -> 'Trainer eased ERG −{pct}% · cadence + power collapsing'; otherwise -> '{coach} eased your target −{pct}% · {label}'.

Live workout HUD (from Workouts -> Endurance -> Intermediate Baseline Ride -> Start Workout) renders correctly at 390px mobile viewport: ELAPSED timer, TOTAL SESSION duration, TERRAIN (grade/elevation/distance left), INTERVAL countdown, ROUTE panel, ERG-related testIDs (3 found), pause control (1 found) all present; no React Native red-screen or console errors observed.
/summary screen (workout summary) renders without crashing on an existing completed 'Threshold Climb' ride -- 'Enter your ride manually' fallback card, View/Save/Share buttons all render correctly.
action_items: None required. This is a low-risk formula/threshold refinement; both backend contract and frontend wiring are verified correct via code review + regression tests. The one item explicitly flagged as best-effort in the review_request -- visually observing the live 'Trainer eased ERG −5% · cadence + power collapsing' toast by driving the exact 10s telemetry pattern through the web/simulated UI -- was not reachable with the available browser-automation tooling (the simulated telemetry source in the web preview does not expose a way to force a precise sustained cadence-variance + power-deficit combination on demand). This remains UNTESTABLE VIA CURRENT TOOLING, consistent with the agent-to-agent context note, and is not counted as a failure.
critical_code_review_comments: struggle.ts erg_spiral gate reads cleanly and matches the spec's exact thresholds (power deficit >10%, cadence <75rpm, cadence CV >10%, sustained over the existing 10s rolling WINDOW_SEC) -- no deviation found.
Good defensive coding: cadenceVariancePct and powerDeficitPct both guard against div-by-zero (avgCad>0, target>0, avgPower>0) before computing ratios.

Minor observation (non-blocking): the live workout flow via the web preview's 'Start Workout' button appeared to carry over stale/leftover ride-completion state from a prior test session's localStorage rather than starting a fresh interactive ride -- this is a pre-existing simulated-mode/test-environment quirk unrelated to this session's struggle.ts/workout.tsx changes, and did not prevent verifying the live HUD renders correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of reachable regression flows passed (workout HUD load, no crash, ERG testIDs present, summary screen render); new erg_spiral toast wording untestable via current simulated-telemetry tooling (expected per review_request)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Priority 1 ERG-mechanical-failure refinement is verified correct at the code/formula/backend-contract level and does not regress the existing struggle-detection/safety/summary flows. The only remaining gap -- visually confirming the exact 'Trainer eased ERG −5% · cadence + power collapsing' toast live in the UI -- requires either a way to inject a precise synthetic telemetry stream (power<target-10%, cadence<75rpm with CV>10%, sustained 10s, ergMode on) into the web preview's simulated-ride source, or a native/BLE-simulator test rig. If such a tool becomes available in a future session, re-run against the 'Intermediate Baseline Ride' or similar ERG workout and watch for the mechanical-failure toast + logControl entry 'Mechanical-failure eased −5% (erg_spiral)'.
